mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS notification_id, m.email AS email, n.title AS title, n.body AS body, n.link AS link, () AS deliverable FROM notification n JOIN member m ON m.id = n.member_id LEFT JOIN notification_setting s ON s.member_id = n.member_id AND s.type = n.type WHERE n.email_status = 'PENDING' AND (n.email_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR n.email_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY n.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF n SKIP LOCKED

UPDATE notification SET email_status = CASE WHEN email_attempt_count + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE email_status END, email_next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN email_attempt_count + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN NULL ELSE #{retryAt} END, email_attempt_count = email_attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND email_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(email_status = 'PENDING'), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(email_status = 'FAILED'), 0) AS failed_count, MIN(CASE WHEN email_status = 'PENDING' THEN created_at END) AS oldest_pending_created_at FROM notification WHERE email_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
